description: FlowSeer repository policy and edit feedback.

hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); hook=$root/tools/hooks/worktree-guard.sh; [ -n "$root" ] && [ -x "$hook" ] || { echo "FlowSeer hook worktree-guard.sh cannot run from $PWD: repository root ${root:-unresolved}, git $(command -v git || echo not on PATH)" >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$hook"
